# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 7 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-base, #02070a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface-base, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #02070a;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-base` | #02070a | #ffffff | Fondo principal de página. Base oscura (#02070A, negro con un toque azul) en el tema dark; blanco en light. |
| `--surface-raised` | #0d1317 | #f4f5f6 | Superficies elevadas o secciones de relevo: Process, FAQ. Contraste de texto verificado con ink e ink-muted. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #02070a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #ffffff | #02070a | Texto principal y títulos sobre surface-base y surface-raised (18:1 o más). |
| `--ink-muted` | #a9b1b7 | #565d64 | Texto secundario, labels e índices. Mínimo 6:1 sobre surface-base y surface-raised. |

### Tokens (7)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #2a3238 | #d8dcdf | Hairlines decorativas: separadores de filas, FAQ, footer. No usar como borde de un control. |
| `--line-strong` | #6b747b | #767d84 | Borde de controles y placeholders (mínimo 3:1 contra el fondo). |
| `--accent` | #0297de | #0297de | Acento principal (azul). 90/10: solo en pocos puntos. Sobre oscuro sirve para texto (6.2:1); sobre blanco solo para relleno o texto de 24px o más (3.2:1). El texto sobre accent va en on-accent. |

| `--tag-bg` | #333333 | #333333 | Fondo fijo de los tags, igual en los dos temas. Con white da 12.6:1. |
| `--overlay` | #02070a73 | #02070a73 | Velo sobre el video o la imagen de fondo del hero (45%). |
| `--overlay-strong` | #02070aa6 | #02070aa6 | Velo más fuerte (65%) cuando el texto necesita más contraste sobre media. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 15rem/0.86 "Jokker", "Bricolage Grotesque", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.06em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-hero); letter-spacing: -0.06em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/TheNightWatch.ttf` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/TheNightWatch.ttf` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/TheNightWatch.ttf`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The Night Watch | `fonts/TheNightWatch.ttf` (weight 400) | `read fonts/TheNightWatch.ttf` | `var(--font-accent)` | `the-night-watch` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 0.25rem;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 0.25rem | Ajuste fino interno. |
| `--space-2` | 0.5rem | Gap entre tags. |
| `--space-3` | 0.75rem | Gap entre elementos pequeños. |
| `--space-4` | 1rem | Gap entre botones. |
| `--space-6` | 1.5rem | Padding horizontal de botón y vertical de header. |
| `--space-8` | 2rem | Gap entre bloques de una sección. |
| `--space-12` | 3rem | Gutter horizontal de página. |
| `--space-16` | 4rem | Gap entre columnas. |
| `--space-24` | 6rem | Padding vertical compacto de sección. |
| `--space-30` | 7.5rem | Padding vertical estándar de sección. |
